# =====================================================================
# The Beit Midrash shelf (2026-11-08). gui/kehillah_domicile_library.gui runs this
# as the Books page shows and whenever a genre tab is chosen. root = the player;
# scope:library = the library shown (the body's Title). It fills the shelves
# and picks the reading-stand books, storing the result on the library's reader
# (kehillah_lib_shelf_layout_effect, generated by scripts/kehillah_library_catalog.py).
# Record: docs/implementation/2026-11-08-library-shelf-and-ledger.md.
# =====================================================================

kehillah_lib_shelf_layout = {
	scope = character
	saved_scopes = { library }
	is_shown = { always = yes }
	is_valid = { always = yes }
	# 2026-11-11 (Daniel: "display it as from the owner's faith, but tooltips
	# should show your own perspective"): the shelf is laid out, coloured and
	# ranked as the library's holder sees it -- his rite's canon -- when he is
	# Jewish; otherwise (a temple library under a gentile lord) as the player
	# sees it. var:kehillah_lib_view_reader on the player names that character;
	# the layout's results are stored on him, and the GUI reads the shelf's
	# values from him. Hover cards and tooltips keep reading the player.
	effect = {
		if = {
			limit = {
				scope:library.holder ?= { is_jewish_character_trigger = yes }
			}
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_view_reader value = scope:library.holder }
		}
		else = {
			set_variable = { name = kehillah_lib_view_reader value = root }
		}
		var:kehillah_lib_view_reader = { kehillah_lib_shelf_layout_effect = yes }
	}
}
